# `Q-12-15` — Listing Feed Skipped: Missing site-url

> A listing has `feed:` configured but the project's
> `website.site-url` is missing; feed generation is skipped.

## What this means

A listing's `feed:` key asks Quarto to emit an Atom/RSS feed
for the listing's items. Every item in the feed needs an
absolute URL — `<link>` and `<id>` elements require it — and
those URLs are built by joining the project's `website.site-url`
to each item's relative path. Without a `site-url`, Quarto
cannot construct the links and refuses to emit a feed that
would be invalid.

The listing's host page renders correctly; only the feed file
(`listing.xml`, or your configured feed path) is skipped.

## Why this happens

The project is missing the `site-url` field in
`_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
website:
  title: "My Site"
  # site-url not set
```

Local-only projects often do not bother setting `site-url`
because most things work without it; feeds are one of the few
features that genuinely require it.

## How to fix

Add `site-url:` under `website:` in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
website:
  title: "My Site"
  site-url: "https://example.com"
```

Use the URL the site will be hosted at in production. The
feed's links are baked into the output at render time, so the
URL needs to be the deploy URL even when you are previewing
locally.
